source_findings: applySizeChartDisplayLabels now restores the saved data-size-display-raw value, or existing raw text, only in the detected Size column of tables under data-matching-set-fallback=true; it returns before age mapping for that cell.

Measurement columns, raw attributes, row selection state and table structure are untouched. All other asset bytes, including cart/native label repairs, measurement conversion, exported formatter, nonfallback table behavior and event listeners, are identical to the staged baseline.

Ordinary initial-page ordering is consistent: the deferred ruler script occurs inside content_for_layout before layout/theme.liquid:1308 loads size-conversion.js. Its builder preflight assigns fallback state before the latter's initial DOMContentLoaded formatting pass.
The unchanged observer handles newly inserted tables and wrappers; cart:updated reprocesses the document. Text-only restoration does not loop through the observer's element-only added-node branch.
